title: 租金降10%：恒地CFO说透，内地商业地产
speaker: Andrew Fong

segments.en: I want to get your take on the mainland as well.
segments.zh: 我也想听听你对内地的看法。

segments.en: It looks like rental in when it comes to the commercial side is seeing still low occupancy.
segments.zh: 商业地产的租金似乎仍然低迷，入住率也低。

segments.en: Rents are also a bit down.
I think you were down some 10% the first half.
Do you see signs of when this sort of sector actually returns to growth again?
segments.zh: 你认为这个行业何时能恢复增长？

segments.en: It's just as a CFO I do not really supervise day to day.
segments.zh: 作为CFO，我并不直接管理日常运营。

segments.en: I doubt that there will be an immediate revival in rentals.
segments.zh: 我怀疑租金会立即回升。

segments.en: As whole AI wave to cut the demand for office space.
segments.zh: 整体上AI浪潮削减了对办公空间的需求。

segments.en: And look at the numbers, I would be doubtful if there will be a certain revival.
segments.zh: 看数据，我对是否会有明显复苏持怀疑态度。

segments.en: I think AI as a whole, well, the mainland's property market is still quite oversupply at the moment.
segments.zh: 我认为AI整体上，内地地产市场目前仍然供过于求。

segments.en: And of course AI and the job market do not have too much.
segments.zh: 当然，AI和就业市场也没有太多关联。

segments.en: So I will not paint a OC picture on the second half for mainland investment properties.
segments.zh: 所以我对下半年内地商业地产的前景并不乐观。
